text: Blind since the age of five, the young violinist Wong Kar-mun has her sight restored by a cornea transplant, then begins to see [shadowy figures who lead the dying away|rules|death sends warnings]. With the psychotherapist Dr. Wah she travels to northern Thailand to find Ling, the donor, a girl [the villagers drove away as a jinx|wrong|the outsider punished] when she foresaw disaster. Ling's grieving mother holds the key to [letting her daughter's spirit go in peace|wants|release and unfinished business], but Kar-mun still sees what Ling once saw.
